name: specbinder
description: Claude Code and Codex skills for SpecBinder: review Gherkin specs against your own guidelines, turn them into JUnit 5 tests, and keep the spec folders tidy.

interface.shortDescription: Review, automate and separate out SpecBinder Gherkin specs.
interface.longDescription: Skills for SpecBinder Gherkin spec files (.specb / .feature): review them against your project's spec-writing guidelines with the findings shown in IntelliJ IDEA's spec editor, turn them into JUnit 5 tests, restructure the spec folders, and separate out the specs of a file that holds several into files of their own.
defaultPrompt: Review the spec file open in the IDE
Automate this spec as a JUnit test
Separate out the specs in this file into their own files
